(3) The man changes his posture to lie down on the white sleeping pad on the tent floor. He demonstrates a side-sleeping position and stretches his right arm off the side of the thick pad, showing the significant height drop to the ground. He looks directly at the lens, explaining how this drop can cause discomfort. (4) The man returns to a kneeling position on the white pad. He points to a yellow and black patch at the top of the pad, identifying it as a dedicated Velcro attachment system. He picks up a blue inflatable pillow and presses it onto the patch to demonstrate how it stays securely in place. He then gives the pad a gentle shake to prove the stability of the pillow-to-pad connection.
